submission.justification: This is not a validated recommendation. No working point was chosen, and the 0% value is a placeholder, not a signal efficiency. The hard 10% data/MC requirement in the signal-free validation region could not be verified for any strategy. The project documents contain no validation-region data/MC yields, and the S2 variable list is missing, so the requirement cannot be applied to S2. No simulate_significance runs were made in this task, so no expected significance exists for any working point. The option label is a provisional placeholder only. S3 is the only candidate that uses kinematic variables alone, which avoids the jet-substructure mismodelling risk attached to S1, but that is a reasoned preference, not a validation result. The 2025 reference values (S1 4.1σ, S3 3.4σ, S2 2.6σ at 50% efficiency, statistical-only) come from simulation_summary_2025.md. They are unvalidated, exclude systematics, and were not used to rank the options. Before any strategy or working point is adopted, the project needs: (1) the S2 variable list, (2) signal-free validation-region data/MC yields for each strategy's variables, (3) re-running the validation, (4) a 20–80% efficiency scan for the strategies that pass, and (5) selection of the highest-significance point, reported as statistical-only.
